name: cip-monorepo
description: Polyglot monorepo for CIP, the open protocol for governed agent operations, plus the staged Lupercal platform implementation.

scripts.build:ts: npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/romulus && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/remus && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-conformance && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/lupercal-api && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/lupercal-worker && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/lupercal-migrate
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:ts: npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/cip && npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/remus && npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-conformance && npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/lupercal-api && npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/lupercal-worker
scripts.test:py: PYTHONPATH=python/packages/cip/src:python/packages/lupercal/src .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s python/packages/cip/tests -p 'test_*.py' && PYTHONPATH=python/packages/cip/src:python/packages/lupercal/src .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s python/packages/lupercal/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json typescript/packages/cip/dist typescript/packages/conformance/dist lupercal/romulus/dist lupercal/remus/dist lupercal/services/api/dist lupercal/services/worker/dist lupercal/services/migrate/dist
